summary_1line: Bhima rampages through Kaurava forces, slays many of Dhritarashtra’s sons, clashes fiercely with Drona, and pushes through enemy divisions to reach Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima hurls his massive mace like a thunderbolt into the Kaurava ranks, smashing chariots and scattering warriors in terror.
Under a storm of arrows from Drona, Bhima leaps from his chariot, seizes Drona’s chariot by the shaft, and violently overturns it.
After breaking through enemy divisions, Bhima roars like thunder upon seeing Arjuna fighting in the distance on the battlefield.
